subject.title: feat(cli): `skills uninstall` design proposal + prior art reconciliation

question: Should OpenClaw add a destructive `openclaw skills uninstall <slug>` CLI now, and should it remove only provenance-valid ClawHub skill directories plus lockfile entries or also support manual skill directories?
rationale: The code path is clear enough to implement, but deleting workspace directories and deciding how manual, stale-lock, global, and agent-scoped installs behave is a product/security contract rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve narrow ClawHub uninstall CLI
options.body: Add a CLI command that deletes only provenance-valid ClawHub skill directories, cleans stale lockfile entries, supports dry-run/JSON/confirmation, and documents the contract.

options.title: Require Gateway-first semantics
options.body: Defer the CLI until a Gateway `skills.uninstall` contract is approved so UI and CLI use the same lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Decline destructive CLI for now
options.body: Keep manual deletion and documentation as the supported path until maintainers want first-class skill removal.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow ClawHub uninstall CLI
recommendation.body: Add a CLI command that deletes only provenance-valid ClawHub skill directories, cleans stale lockfile entries, supports dry-run/JSON/confirmation, and documents the contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the native ClawHub install and skills CLI flows that the proposed command extends.
